description: An acceptance binds committed text, spec drafting and acceptance are refused where spec tests cannot run, and a generation keeps its failing tests and sets aside the ones that already pass.

specs.given: a Rust project whose spec file is tracked and unmodified against HEAD
specs.then: it records the acceptance and exits 0

specs.given: a spec file git does not track
specs.then: it exits non-zero, says the spec is untracked, names `git add` and `git commit` as the step to take, and leaves the spec file unchanged

specs.description: A modified spec HEAD holds no acceptance of is refused
specs.given: a tracked spec file edited in the working tree, where HEAD's version carries no acceptance that matches it
specs.then: it exits non-zero, says the spec is modified, names `git commit`, and leaves the spec file unchanged

specs.description: A re-acceptance may be of an edited working-tree spec
specs.given: a spec whose acceptance HEAD holds, edited in the working tree
specs.then: it records the acceptance and exits 0

specs.description: Accept is refused with no Cargo.toml
specs.given: a project with a spec and no Cargo.toml at its root
specs.then: it exits non-zero with the same message as `spec draft`, naming Cargo.toml and that tests are generated for Rust only, and leaves the spec file unchanged

specs.description: Accept proceeds in a Rust project
specs.given: a project with a Cargo.toml at its root and a committed spec
specs.then: no Cargo.toml refusal is printed and the acceptance is recorded

specs.description: At HEAD the red tests are kept and the green ones set aside as guards
specs.given: an accepted spec and a generation in which one test passes before the code and the others fail
specs.when: `hexa spec tests <ADR>` runs with no option, proving red at HEAD
specs.then: the failing tests are committed and their commit is red, the passing test is left out of the file and reported as a guard, and its scenario stays pending

specs.description: A generation in which every test passes is refused
specs.given: a generation in which every test passes before the code
specs.then: it refuses the generation, leaves no test file in the tree and commits nothing

specs.description: With --red-at a green test still refuses the generation
specs.given: a generation in which one test passes at the named red commit
specs.then: it refuses the generation, leaves no test file in the tree and commits nothing

specs.description: The amended fixtures are recorded and verify
specs.given: the specs of ADR-2610221540, ADR-2610281516 and ADR-2611062141 after their fixtures commit the spec before accepting it and the ADR-2611062141 fixture carries a Cargo.toml
specs.then: every scenario passes, none is pending, and each changed sealed file's seal is carried by a recorded amendment

specs.description: A fixture edited without an amendment is drift
specs.given: a sealed fixture file edited with no `hexa spec amend` recorded
specs.then: it fails, reporting the seal broken
